stem.text: A wire is stretched by applying increasing values of force $F$. For each value of force applied, the extension $x$ is recorded. A force–extension graph is plotted from the data obtained.
Which statement about the area under the graph **must** be correct?

B.text: It is the elastic potential energy stored in the stretched sample.

C.text: It is the work done in stretching the sample.

D.text: It would be the same for any wire of the same material.
